# Win-back playbook

*Generated by `python -m fdda.analysis.customers` (dev data, snapshot 2020-09-23). Numbers come from `reports/customers/*_dev.csv`.*

## Summary

135,989 customers were scored on recency, frequency and monetary value. The 4 segments below are the churned or at-risk ones: 54,461 customers (40% of the base) with 11,252,105 indexed revenue at stake (their spend in the year before their last purchase). Offers are capped at the Phase 3 markdown ceiling: **5-15% (max 10% off)**, beyond which deeper discounts cut margin.

## Playbook

| Segment | Customers | Churned (120d) | Revenue at stake | Per customer | Favourite categories | Buys on discount | Responds to | Offer | Action | Channel | Timing | Success KPI |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Can't Lose** | 1,035 (1%) | 100% | 1,274,350 | 1,231 | Garment Upper body (42%), Garment Lower body (22%), Garment Full body (11%) | 39% of units | 55%+ | 10% (capped) | Personal re-engagement: early access to the new season plus a capped offer | Email + app push, personalised by favourite category | Now, then 2-3 weeks before each seasonal peak | Reactivation within 60 days vs a 10% holdout; incremental revenue per contact |
| **At Risk** | 12,783 (9%) | 100% | 5,225,543 | 409 | Garment Upper body (41%), Garment Lower body (22%), Garment Full body (10%) | 36% of units | 35-45% | 10% (capped) | 3-touch email series: new arrivals in favourite categories, then the offer | Email (online-heavy segment), store receipt message for in-store buyers | When recency passes 90 days; series over 3 weeks | Second purchase within 45 days vs holdout |
| **Hibernating** | 16,480 (12%) | 100% | 1,980,318 | 120 | Garment Upper body (40%), Garment Lower body (21%), Garment Full body (10%) | 45% of units | 5-15% | 10% (capped) | Low-cost content-led nudge; offer only on the last touch | Newsletter / owned channels only (no paid media) | At season launches | Reactivation rate and offer cost per reactivated customer |
| **Lost** | 24,163 (18%) | 100% | 2,771,894 | 115 | Garment Upper body (43%), Garment Lower body (22%), Garment Full body (8%) | 42% of units | 5-15% | 10% (capped) | One final reactivation message, then sunset from campaigns | Single email; suppress from paid retargeting | Once, at the next major sale event | Reactivation rate; list hygiene (unsubscribes, bounces) |

* **Revenue at stake** = indexed revenue in the 365 days up to each customer's last purchase: the yearly spend that lapses if they do not come back.
* **Responds to** = the discount band where the segment buys a larger share of its units than the customer base does.
* **Offer** = the segment's median discount when it buys on discount, rounded down to 5%, capped at the Phase 3 ceiling. Run every offer against a holdout group so the KPI measures incremental, not total, reactivation.

## Caveats

* Scores are relative (percentile ranks within this customer base).
* The data ends on the snapshot date, so a long gap may be seasonal rather than permanent churn; the sensitivity table shows how much the window matters.
* Discount behaviour is observational: a segment that bought on discount may have bought anyway. The holdout design in the KPI column is what proves incrementality.
